title: Polish-Style Zesty Pork Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful Polish-inspired dish featuring zesty pork and herbal notes, served in a bowl.

ingredients.name: Herbs (such as parsley, dill, or thyme)

instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt, pepper, and zesty seasoning blend.
Sear the pork shoulder in a hot skillet for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the pork to a baking dish and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the pork is cooking, heat the apple cider vinegar in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the saucepan and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until softened.
Add the sliced Polish sausage to the saucepan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
To assemble the bowls, slice the cooked pork and place it in the bottom of a bowl.
Add a spoonful of the onion and sausage mixture on top of the pork.
Garnish with chopped herbs and serve immediately.
